scope: Root-led source, model-specification and complete generator-code inspection of all nine frozen constructions. No independent human or second-model scientific review is claimed. Numerical results are separately recomputed by the independent QR implementation.

constructions.law: Bounded covariates; correlated bounded radial errors with a common covariate-dependent support scale.
constructions.reason: Age, BMI and both BP outcomes are bounded. The residual radial law sqrt(6*Beta(1,2)) has identity covariance before loading; common scale preserves zero conditional mean and nominal correlation.
constructions.source_composition: Agent independently wrote the source Schur-complement expressions and approximately 0.788; selected 0.70 as an explicit transport scenario.
constructions.caveat: Residual SDs vary with the support scale; source and target covariance are not identified as equal.

constructions.law: Bounded beta covariates; bivariate Student t with source-derived age/BMI projection covariance, conditionally truncated by paired BP support.
constructions.reason: All released variables are bounded. Underlying t has df=8 and finite variance even before conditioning.
constructions.source_composition: Agent independently assembles Rxx/Ryx/Ryy and computes the Schur complement in its sampler; source-only residual correlation approximately 0.788.
constructions.caveat: Transferred covariance omits sex in source; outcome rejection alters slopes and residual relation from preconstraint values. Agent documents these effects.

constructions.law: Discrete age bands; conditionally truncated lognormal BMI; correlated Gaussian BP errors with nonlinear DBP age term, conditionally restricted by BP/pulse-pressure support.
constructions.reason: Bounded age/BMI and released BP. Gaussian proposal also has finite moments.
constructions.source_composition: Explicitly treats BF2018 additions as marginal context only. Nominal 0.55 remains an assumed scenario loosely informed by the old Beijing raw correlations.
constructions.caveat: DBP age curvature omitted from the requested linear projection and conditional rejection can alter residual relation and slopes.

constructions.law: Discrete age bands; bounded lognormal BMI; shared-radial Student t BP errors with df=8, age hinge for DBP, conditional support rejection.
constructions.reason: Bounded output; underlying t also has finite variance. BMI median stays positive throughout allowed covariates.
constructions.source_composition: Beijing raw covariance is correctly labeled derived/raw; target preconstraint correlation 0.55 explicitly assumed.
constructions.caveat: Conditioning and nonlinear age mean make nominal error parameters differ from requested linear analysis.

constructions.law: Bounded covariates; heteroscedastic paired Gaussian BP with DBP age hinge, conditionally truncated to BP and pulse-pressure support.
constructions.reason: All released variables bounded; SBP conditional scale stays 14–19.9 over the allowed age range, BMI pretruncation mean stays positive.
constructions.source_composition: Uses BF2018 as marginal scale context only; explicitly declines to infer adjusted dependence from it. Nominal rho is an assumed choice with old Beijing raw context.
constructions.caveat: Heteroscedasticity, nonlinear age hinge and support conditioning alter pooled linear-residual correlation.

constructions.law: Bounded beta age and lognormal BMI; affine BP with row-wise uniform-sphere coordinate errors (dimension 5).
constructions.reason: Covariates bounded; sphere errors bounded with identity covariance, so affine BP has finite moments of all orders.
constructions.source_composition: BF marginals used as level/scale context only; nominal residual covariance is assumed, not inferred from marginal moments.
constructions.caveat: Light bounded tails are an unvalidated law choice. No BP rejection or global moment forcing.
constructions.physical_check: Across the declared covariate box, minimum mean pulse pressure is 39.0343 mmHg and maximum adverse residual difference is sqrt(800)=28.2843; sufficient pulse-pressure lower bound about 10.75 mmHg. Systolic and diastolic minima are positive.

constructions.law: Bounded beta age and conditionally truncated shifted-lognormal BMI; paired Gaussian BP with a DBP age-60 hinge and conditional BP/pulse-pressure rejection.
constructions.reason: All released covariates/outcomes are bounded; Gaussian and lognormal proposals have finite moments as well.
constructions.source_composition: INTERSALT unit conversion retained as an assumed target mean anchor; Beijing raw correlations only contextual, residual rho explicitly assumed.
constructions.caveat: Conditional rejection and omitted DBP age hinge change final projections; bounds do not reconstruct target dictionary extremes.

constructions.law: Bounded age bands and conditionally truncated lognormal BMI; paired Gaussian BP with quadratic age surfaces and joint support conditioning.
constructions.reason: Bounded output with positive Gaussian acceptance region at every fixed covariate vector; BMI median positive throughout.
constructions.source_composition: Converted INTERSALT coefficients used as assumed anchors; Beijing raw covariance does not identify adjusted dependence.
constructions.caveat: Nonlinear age surfaces and conditional rejection change requested linear projections.

constructions.law: Bounded beta age and shifted-lognormal BMI; paired Gaussian BP with nonlinear age term and conditional support rejection.
constructions.reason: All released variables bounded; BMI pretruncation mean minus shift stays positive throughout covariate support.
constructions.source_composition: Agent independently derived BF2018 source age/BMI residual correlation approximately 0.788 and age-adjusted BMI slopes approximately 3.745 and 2.369; chose rho 0.70 as a transport assumption, retaining INTERSALT BMI anchors.
constructions.caveat: Source derivation excludes sex; target rho selection is a scenario, not a pooled or identified estimate. Conditional rejection and nonlinear DBP age surface alter final analysis.
